name: security-externaldns-record-authority-review
intent: ExternalDNS source-object control and DNS zone delegation
artifacts: Controller sources/filters, ownership registry, zone permissions and source object writers.
trace: Follow a resource annotation/hostname into DNS changes under the controller identity. Determine tenant/zone boundaries and collision/takeover behavior.
experiment: Use a local provider stub or owned test zone; compare a permitted record with an out-of-tenant name requested by a lower-trust resource writer.
disproof: A requested hostname or dry-run log is not an actual DNS change; never claim or overwrite unrelated domains.
repair: Bind source writers to permitted zones/names and verify conflict handling, deletion and legitimate reconciliation.
branch_decisions: Resolve controller sources, domain filters, namespace/label selectors and provider credentials. A TXT ownership record coordinates controllers; it is not universally an authorization boundary against a cluster actor who controls admitted sources. Show which owned zone/record the restricted source can influence and distinguish provider-side IAM denial from a controller filtering decision.
